result.releaseSummary: Critical fix for companion preferences management, ensuring preferences are stored per user and do not overwrite authentication credentials. UI enhancements added for user interaction.
risks: {"file":"app/lib/agents/companion-preferences.ts","issue":"Current user validation is required before preferences write, but the implementation must be verified to ensure it cannot be bypassed.","remediation":"Verify that the user role and active status checks are correctly enforced before any write operation."}

{"file":"app/api/agents/companion/route.ts","issue":"The POST route allows for preferences to be saved, but there is a risk of role revocation occurring between the read and write operations.","remediation":"Implement additional checks to ensure that the user's role has not changed between reading preferences and saving them."}

{"file":"app/lib/auth/guards.ts","issue":"The requireUser function must ensure that the user is both active and verified before allowing access to sensitive operations.","remediation":"Confirm that the requireUser function is consistently applied across all routes that handle sensitive data."}
smokeTests: Verify that the UI displays the new shared original animated characters.

regressionTests: Ensure that existing user preferences are not overwritten by new preferences.

edgeCases: Test behavior when a user attempts to save preferences while their role is revoked.

adminChecks: Verify that admin users can access all features without restrictions.
Ensure that editor users are restricted to their assigned scopes.
thirdPartyChecks: Confirm that the integration with OpenAI API is functioning as expected and that the system handles cases where it is not configured.

rollbackSteps: Revert to the previous stable version of the companion preferences management.

result.cursorFixPrompt: Verify that user role checks are enforced before saving preferences and ensure that role revocation is handled correctly during preference updates.
